headline: DDR v5 condemns a coin only on terminal evidence, and Safety Score ships twelve releases to 10.34.
fieldNotes: The week went into making verdicts and warnings mean what they say. Every DDR v4 miss was a coin condemned on a break that later recovered; v5 waits for terminal evidence. Safety Score folded parallel scorers into one authority ladder. Public warnings and Telegram alerts now fire only on problems that persist or matter. Underneath, a lost cron slot on the main lanes now gets one catch-up run instead of a missing publication.

summary.label: Safety Score 10.34
summary.description: Twelve releases, 10.23 to 10.34. 10.29 replaces parallel authority scorers with one economic-authority ladder and five cap families, 10.30 grades active depegs by severity, and scores now publish hourly.

summary.label: DDR v5 verdicts
summary.description: Verdicts condemn a coin only on terminal evidence, so static exit thinness no longer does. Duration reads as recovery odds that keep non-recovery visible, and reviews grade calls against naive baselines.

summary.label: Telegram bot v2
summary.description: Safety alerts need a two-notch downgrade or a fall to D/F held six hours; freeze alerts need a destruction or $1M. Other changes arrive in one daily message, and the Mini App drops its tabs.

summary.label: Quieter public warnings
summary.description: Readers see warnings only for data past the 12x stale band, missing, or quarantined; lesser findings go to operators. /status ignores small bounded omissions and needs two evaluations to change state.

summary.label: Search-ready profiles
summary.description: Coin profiles lead with a dated Safety grade, a redemption answer and checksum-validated ISINs for fund tokens. Titles use searchers' words, and thin chain, depeg-event and digest pages leave the index.

summary.label: Design-system completion
summary.description: The raw-palette ledger is drained and deleted, every corner radius snaps to the scale, and CSS modules sit on named layers. Lint now rejects new raw hues and arbitrary radii; titles are sentence case.

summary.label: Venue and price coverage
summary.description: Aero, the merged Aerodrome and Velodrome, is read directly (Liquidity 6.98, Pricing 6.56). Hive HBD gains depth-gated cross-rates, USDY prices again, and DefiLlama-delisted USYC, reUSD and USP route via CoinGecko.

summary.label: FreezeWatch and evidence
summary.description: FreezeWatch adopts a written exposure procedure, re-reviews every active status, and measures Upstream exposure on external backing only (4.4, 4.5). VCRED is delisted, USDKG frozen, AI summaries refreshed.

summary.label: Cron and integrity sweep
summary.description: Missed or abandoned cron slots get one catch-up run and non-price lanes slow to owner-approved cadences. A correctness sweep ships across nine methodologies, and sponsor Dwellir now serves native reads first.
